introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: This Privacy Policy explains how Vanessa MP collects, uses, and protects information when you visit this portfolio website.

provided.title: Information You Provide
provided.content: If you contact me through email or other communication methods, I may collect your name, email address, and any information you choose to share.

automatic.title: Automatically Collected Information
automatic.content: This website may collect limited technical information such as IP address, browser type, device information, visited pages, and usage statistics.

useOfInformation.title: Use of Information
useOfInformation.content: Collected information may be used to respond to inquiries, discuss professional opportunities, improve website performance, and maintain website security.

thirdPartyServices.title: Third-Party Services
thirdPartyServices.content: This website may contain links to external platforms such as LinkedIn. I am not responsible for the privacy practices or content of third-party websites.

dataRetention.title: Data Retention
dataRetention.content: Personal information is retained only for as long as necessary to respond to inquiries and maintain professional communications.

dataSecurity.title: Data Security
dataSecurity.content: Reasonable measures are taken to protect personal information from unauthorized access, disclosure, or misuse.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.content: Depending on applicable laws, you may have the right to access, correct, delete, or object to the processing of your personal information.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.content: This Privacy Policy may be updated from time to time. Any changes will be published on this page.

contact.title: Contact
contact.content: If you have any questions regarding this Privacy Policy, please use the contact information available on this website.
